# Bundlebase

> Docker for data. Bundle, query with SQL, extend with Python.

Bundlebase packages data files into versioned bundles with a SQL query engine, custom functions, custom connectors, and Python/CLI interfaces.

## Docs
- [SQL Reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nvoxland/bundlebase/main/docs/sql-reference/index.md): Full command syntax
- [Connector SDK](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nvoxland/bundlebase/main/sdk/python/bundlebase_sdk/README.md): Custom connectors
- [Function SDK](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nvoxland/bundlebase/main/docs/user-guide/functions.md): Custom functions
- [Python API](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nvoxland/bundlebase/main/docs/api/sync.md): Full sync API docs
- [CLI Reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nvoxland/bundlebase/main/docs/guide/cli-repl.md): CLI usage

## Quick Reference

### Installation

```
pip install bundlebase
```

### Python API (bundlebase.sync)

```python
import bundlebase.sync as bb

# Factory functions
c = bb.create("./my-bundle")      # new bundle -> SyncBundleBuilder
c = bb.create()                    # in-memory bundle
b = bb.open("./my-bundle")        # existing bundle -> SyncBundle (read-only)

# To mutate a read-only bundle:
c = b.extend()                     # -> SyncBundleBuilder

# Data operations (SyncBundleBuilder, all return self for chaining)
c.attach("data.parquet")
c.attach("more.csv", pack="my_join")
c.filter("SELECT * FROM bundle WHERE salary > $1", [50000])
c.join("orders", on="id = order_id", location="orders.parquet", how="inner")
c.drop_join("orders")
c.drop_column("email")
c.rename_column("first_name", "name")
c.add_column("full_name", "first_name || ' ' || last_name")
c.cast_column("age", "integer")
c.standardize_column_names()
c.set_name("My Bundle")
c.set_description("Customer data")

# Query -> SyncQueryResult
result = c.query("SELECT name, salary FROM bundle WHERE active = true", [])
result = c.query("SELECT * FROM bundle", hard_limit=100)   # DataFrame-level row cap
df = result.to_pandas()
df = result.to_polars()
d  = result.to_dict()

# Direct conversion from bundle
df = c.to_pandas()
df = c.to_polars()
d  = c.to_dict()
a  = c.to_numpy()

# Sources & Fetch
c.create_source("remote_dir", {"url": "s3://bucket/data/"})
c.fetch(pack="base", mode="add")       # mode: add | update | sync
c.fetch_all(mode="add")

# Views
c.create_view("active_users", "SELECT * FROM bundle WHERE active = true")

# Functions
c.import_function("acme.double_val", "ipc::./my_funcs", platform="*/*")
c.import_temp_function("acme.double_val", "python::my_module:double_val")
c.drop_function("acme.double_val")
c.drop_temp_function("acme.double_val")

# Connectors
c.import_connector("acme.weather", "ipc::./my_connector")
c.import_temp_connector("acme.weather", "python::my_module:MyConnector")
c.drop_connector("acme.weather")
c.drop_temp_connector("acme.weather")

# Versioning
c.commit("Added customer data")
c2 = c.extend()                        # new builder from committed bundle

# Introspection
c.schema          # PySchema with .fields, .field(name)
c.name            # str or None
c.description     # str or None
c.version         # 12-char hex string
c.url             # storage path
c.num_rows()      # int
c.history()       # list of commits
c.status()        # list of uncommitted changes
c.explain()       # query execution plan
```

### SQL Commands

```sql
-- Data
ATTACH '<path>' [TO <pack>]
DETACH '<location>'
REPLACE '<old>' WITH '<new>'
FILTER WITH <select_query>

-- Schema
JOIN '<source>' AS <name> ON <condition>
DROP JOIN <name>
DROP COLUMN <name>
RENAME COLUMN <old> TO <new>
CREATE VIEW <name> AS <sql>
DROP VIEW <name>

-- Sources
TEST CONNECTOR <name> [WITH (key = 'val', ...)]
TEST TEMP CONNECTOR '<runtime>::<entrypoint>' [WITH (key = 'val', ...)]
CREATE SOURCE [FOR <pack>] USING <connector> [WITH (key = 'val', ...)] [SAVE AS <AUTO|COPY|PARQUET|REF>]
FETCH <pack> <ADD|UPDATE|SYNC> [DRY RUN]
FETCH ALL <ADD|UPDATE|SYNC> [DRY RUN]

-- Functions
IMPORT FUNCTION <ns.name> FROM '<runtime>::<entrypoint>'
IMPORT TEMP FUNCTION <ns.name> FROM '<runtime>::<entrypoint>'
IMPORT FUNCTION <ns>.* FROM '<runtime>::<entrypoint>'
DROP FUNCTION <ns.name> [FOR PLATFORM '<platform>']
DESCRIBE FUNCTION <ns.name>

-- Connectors
IMPORT CONNECTOR <name> FROM '<runtime>::<entrypoint>'
IMPORT TEMP CONNECTOR <name> FROM '<runtime>::<entrypoint>'
DROP CONNECTOR <name> [FOR PLATFORM '<platform>']
DESCRIBE CONNECTOR <name>

-- Indexes
CREATE <COLUMN|TEXT> INDEX ON <column>
DROP INDEX <column>
REBUILD INDEX ON <column>
REINDEX

-- Version control
COMMIT '<message>'
RESET
UNDO [LAST <count>]
EXPLAIN [ANALYZE] [VERBOSE] [FORMAT format] [sql]

-- Metadata
SET NAME '<name>'
SET DESCRIPTION '<desc>'

-- Built-in functions
SELECT * FROM search('<index_name>', '<query>')
```

Runtimes for functions/connectors: `python`, `ipc`, `ffi`, `java`, `docker`.
`python` runtime requires TEMP (session-only) imports. Persistent imports use other runtimes.

### Custom Connector (Connector ABC)

```python
from bundlebase_sdk.source import Connector
from bundlebase_sdk.types import Location

class MyConnector(Connector):
    def discover(self, attached_locations: list[str], **kwargs: str) -> list[Location]:
        """Return list of available data locations."""
        ...

    def data(self, location: Location, **kwargs: str):
        """Return data as pa.Table, pa.RecordBatch, list[dict], or None."""
        ...

    # Optional overrides:
    # def schema(self) -> dict[str, str] | None:  # for dict->Arrow conversion
    # def stable_url(self, location, **kwargs) -> StableUrl | None:
```

Register: `c.import_temp_connector("acme.my_conn", "python::my_module:MyConnector")`
Then: `c.create_source("acme.my_conn", {"key": "value"})`

### Custom Function (Python scalar)

```python
import pyarrow as pa
import pyarrow.compute as pc

def double_val(col: pa.Array) -> pa.Array:
    return pc.multiply(col, 2)

def bundlebase_metadata():
    return [{"name": "double_val", "input_types": ["Int64"], "return_type": "Int64", "kind": "scalar"}]
```

Register: `c.import_temp_function("acme.double_val", "python::my_module:double_val")`

### Custom Function (Python aggregate)

```python
import pyarrow as pa
import pyarrow.compute as pc

class MySum:
    def create_state(self):
        return pa.scalar(0, type=pa.int64())
    def accumulate(self, state, values):
        return pa.scalar(state.as_py() + pc.sum(values).as_py(), type=pa.int64())
    def merge(self, state1, state2):
        return pa.scalar(state1.as_py() + state2.as_py(), type=pa.int64())
    def evaluate(self, state):
        return state

def bundlebase_metadata():
    return [{"name": "my_sum", "input_types": ["Int64"], "return_type": "Int64", "kind": "aggregate"}]
```

### Function SDK (IPC provider ABC)

```python
from bundlebase_sdk.function import Function

class MyFunctions(Function):
    def functions(self) -> list[dict]:
        return [{"name": "double_val", "input_types": ["Int64"], "return_type": "Int64", "kind": "scalar"}]
    def invoke(self, name: str, batch: pa.RecordBatch):
        return pc.multiply(batch.column(0), 2)
    # Aggregate: override create_state(), accumulate(), merge(), evaluate()
```

### CLI Usage

```bash
# Non-interactive execute mode (agent-friendly)
bundlebase --bundle ./sales --create --execute "ATTACH 'raw_sales.csv'"
bundlebase --bundle ./sales --execute "SELECT * FROM bundle LIMIT 5" --format json
bundlebase --bundle ./sales --execute "FILTER WITH SELECT * FROM bundle WHERE amount > 0"
bundlebase --bundle ./sales --execute "COMMIT 'Cleaned sales data'"
bundlebase --bundle ./sales --execute "/schema" --format json
bundlebase --bundle ./sales --execute "/count" --format json

# Interactive REPL
bundlebase --bundle ./my-bundle --create
bundlebase --bundle ./my-bundle
bundlebase --bundle ./my-bundle --read-only
bundlebase --bundle ./my-bundle --format json   # JSON output in REPL too

# Remote bundles
bundlebase --bundle s3://mybucket/my-bundle
```

`--format`: `table` (default) or `json`. JSON mode outputs arrays of objects for queries, single values/objects for commands.
`--execute`: Run one command and exit. Errors go to stderr as `{"error": "..."}` in JSON mode. Exit code 1 on error.
Query results are hard-limited to 1000 rows. Use `LIMIT` in SQL for fewer.

REPL meta-commands: `/help`, `/show`, `/schema`, `/count`, `/status`, `/history`, `/exit`
